userMenu.label: Account
userMenu.devModeTitle: Dev-token bypass identity (dev-user) — sign in to use your real identity

account.profileHint: Your identity across the workspace — how collaborators see you.
account.editorHint: How the editor behaves for you: keymap, startup mode, fonts, and shortcuts.
account.displayNameHint: Overrides the name from your identity provider. It is shown to collaborators.
account.avatarHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 512KB. Shown on your cursor and in member lists.
account.keymapHint: How the editor opens (synced across your devices). Ctrl+Alt+V toggles vim for the current session.
account.shortcutsHint: Synced across your devices. Press a key combo to rebind.
account.kbReserved: That combo is reserved by the browser.
account.kbDuplicate: That combo is already used by another shortcut.
account.displayModeHint: How the editor opens its syntax: Live reveals it under the cursor, Source shows it always. Orthogonal to vim. Local follows this device.
account.bodyFontHint: The prose face in the editor and reading view (this device). Follow language uses the locale default (Japanese = UDEV Gothic, English = Wikistead Mono). Code always uses the coding face.
account.tocHint: Show an outline of the page's headings.
account.tocDepthHint: How many heading levels the outline includes.
account.appearanceHint: Light, dark, or follow your system.
account.accentHint: Your personal accent colour. Overrides the workspace accent for you only.
account.dataHint: Take your knowledge out in open formats.
account.chromeHint: Choose which editor controls are visible. Hiding a control never disables the feature.
account.chromeModesHint: Modes offered by the display-mode switch (at least one stays on; hidden modes are skipped by the cycle shortcut).

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.desc: Control what lands in your in-app inbox. These only reduce what you receive — access to content is always enforced separately.
notifications.enabledHint: Turn off to stop all in-app notifications (your watches are kept).
notifications.defaultMaskHint: Applied to watches without their own type filter. All types are on by default.

settings.forbiddenBody: You need administrator permission to view this area.
settings.notFoundBody: This page doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.

adminPublic.title: Public access
adminPublic.body: The master switch for this workspace's anonymous public pages. While it's off, every public page is unreachable (returns not-found) — a structural block against accidental exposure. Turning it off is non-destructive: per-page public settings are kept and restored when you turn it back on.
adminPublic.toggleTitle: Allow public pages in this workspace
adminPublic.onHint: On — pages marked public can be viewed by anyone with the link.
adminPublic.offHint: Off — all public pages are hidden, even if individually marked public.

adminEmbeds.title: External embeds
adminEmbeds.body: Hosts allowed to be embedded as sandboxed iframes (e.g. video). External embeds are off by default — anything not listed here degrades to a plain link. https is implied.
adminEmbeds.empty: No allowed hosts — all external embeds degrade to a link.
adminEmbeds.invalidHost: Enter a valid host, e.g. youtube.com
adminEmbeds.ownOrigin: This app's own origin can't be embedded.

adminOrphans.title: Orphan drafts
adminOrphans.body: Drafts whose creator was deleted and that no one else can see. Claim one to read it, then reassign it to a member. Claiming grants you temporary access that is revoked on reassign (or expires automatically).
adminOrphans.claimed: Claimed — you now have temporary access.

billing.title: Billing
billing.selfHosted: This is a self-hosted workspace — all features are included, with no plan limits or billing.
billing.teamNote: Need SSO provisioning, audit logs, or annual invoicing? Contact us about the Team plan.
billing.portalUnavailable: No billing set up yet — upgrade first.

adminApi.title: API
adminApi.body: API keys act with your own permissions. A read key can only read; the scope never grants more than you have.
adminApi.name: Key name
adminApi.copyOnce: Copy this key now — it won't be shown again.

adminAuth.title: Authentication
adminAuth.body: Configure your organization's identity provider (OIDC) for member sign-in.
adminAuth.warning: Changing these settings affects how everyone signs in. Use Test connection and enable only a verified configuration — your current session stays active so you can fix mistakes.
adminAuth.clientSecretKeep: Leave blank to keep the current secret
adminAuth.enabled: Use this identity provider for sign-in
adminAuth.testOk: Discovery succeeded — this issuer looks reachable.
adminAuth.saveFailed: Couldn't save — test the connection first.

adminEnroll.title: Auto-enrolment
adminEnroll.body: Decide who a successful sign-in adds as a member. A seat limit still bounds how many.
adminEnroll.policyHint_open: Any user who signs in via your IdP becomes a member (within the seat limit).
adminEnroll.policyHint_domain: Only users whose email domain you have verified below are auto-enrolled.
adminEnroll.policyHint_groups: Only users in one of the allowed IdP groups are auto-enrolled.
adminEnroll.policyHint_invite_only: No auto-enrolment — members join only by accepting an invite.
adminEnroll.verifyFailed: Couldn't verify — publish the DNS TXT record and try again.

adminSpaces.title: Spaces
adminSpaces.name: Name
adminSpaces.creationPolicyBody: Who may create new spaces in this tenant. Personal spaces are always allowed.

spaceSettings.title: {{name}} · Settings
spaceSettings.iconHint: Upload an image, or leave it empty to show an auto-generated initials chip from the name.
spaceSettings.shareHint: Create a share link to this whole space (all published pages). Choose view-only or editable (editable = an anonymously writable public wiki).
spaceSettings.publicTitle: Make this space public on the web
spaceSettings.publicHint: Anyone on the internet can read this space's PUBLISHED pages — private pages and drafts stay hidden.
spaceSettings.publicOnHint: This space is public: every published, non-private page is readable by anyone on the internet.
spaceSettings.publicRestrictNote: Note: a per-page "restrict" list does NOT hide a page from the public tree — only "private" removes it from public view.
spaceSettings.publicErrorSurface: The public surface is turned off for this workspace (an admin can enable it).
spaceSettings.deleteHint: Deleting a space permanently removes it and all of its pages.
spaceSettings.deleteConfirm: Delete space "{{name}}" and all of its pages? This cannot be undone.
spaceSettings.pageCreationBody: Who may create new pages in this space. Applies to every way a page is created (new, duplicate, template, import).

spaceTrash.title: Trash
spaceTrash.hint: Deleted pages stay here for 30 days, then they are removed permanently. Restoring brings back the page, its sub-pages, and its sharing settings exactly as they were.
spaceTrash.restoredReparented: Page restored (moved to the space root — its old parent is gone)
spaceTrash.purgeConfirm: Permanently delete "{{name}}" and its sub-pages? This cannot be undone.

spacePages.title: Pages
spacePages.empty: No pages in this space yet.

spaceMembers.title: Members & permissions
spaceMembers.body: Grant members access to this space. Access flows to every published page in it.
spaceMembers.commentAudienceBody: Allow commenting on this space's pages. A per-member comment grant is set on each page; these toggles open commenting to a whole audience.
spaceMembers.commentGuests: Guests with a view link may comment
spaceMembers.commentMembers: Anyone who can view (public) may comment

auth.signInBody: Continue with your organization's identity provider.
auth.errorAccess: Sign-in couldn't be completed. Please try again or contact your workspace administrator.
auth.errorSeatFull: This workspace has reached its member limit. Ask an administrator to free a seat or upgrade.
auth.joinBody: Sign up with your identity provider to get started.
auth.workspaceBody: This becomes your subdomain. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
auth.inviteBody: Sign in to accept your invitation and join the workspace.
auth.errorIdpUnavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.

share.invalid: This share link is invalid, expired, or revoked.
share.spaceEmpty: This space has no published pages yet.
share.newPageRateLimited: Page creation is temporarily limited. Try again later.
share.passwordThrottled: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.

page.vimTouchDisabled: Vim is unavailable on touch devices (soft-keyboard input)
page.exportHtmlDisabled: HTML export is temporarily unavailable while it's being rebuilt.
page.printDisabled: Print / PDF is temporarily unavailable while the render pipeline is being rebuilt.
page.frozenFull: Frozen — read-only for everyone below manager
page.frozenGuests: Frozen for guests — members can still edit
page.notFound: This page doesn't exist. It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.

sidebar.deletePageConfirm: Move page "{{name}}" and its sub-pages to the trash? You can restore it from the space settings for 30 days.
sidebar.noSpaces: No spaces yet — create one above.
sidebar.noPages: No pages yet — add one above.

shareDialog.title: Share page
shareDialog.spaceWarning: Anyone with this link can view every published page in this space — including pages you add later. An editable link also allows anonymous editing and page creation.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.body: Grant members access to this page. An unpublished page is private to the people listed here.
permissions.restrictTitle: Restricted (denied even if a space viewer)
permissions.privateHint: Only the people you list below can view or edit it; space members no longer inherit access, and it won't be public. Child pages are not made private automatically.
permissions.privateOnHint: This page is private — only the people in the allow list below can access it. Space members do not inherit access.
permissions.freezeHint: Lock the page body against edits. Managers can always edit; commenting stays open for viewers.
permissions.freezeGuestsHint: Frozen for share-link guests — members can still edit. Managers can always edit.
permissions.freezeFullHint: Frozen for everyone below manager — members and guests are read-only. Managers can always edit.
permissions.publicHint: Anyone with the link can view the published page anonymously — no account needed. Only published pages can be made public; it's excluded from search engines.
permissions.publicOnHint: This page is public — anyone can view the published version anonymously.
permissions.publicPrivateConflict: A private page can't be made public. Turn off private first.
permissions.publicDraftHint: Publish the page first — only a published page can be made public.
permissions.publicErrorDraft: Only a published page can be made public. Publish it first.
permissions.publicErrorSurface: The public surface is turned off for this workspace (an admin can enable it).
permissions.publicErrorPrivate: A private page can't be made public. Turn off private first.
permissions.publicViaSpace: This page is already reachable publicly through its space (space-level public), even with this toggle off.
permissions.allowlistTitle: Allow list (only these people can access this private page)
permissions.privateConfirmBody: {{count}} active share link(s) for this page will be revoked and can't be restored. Space members will lose inherited access.
permissions.commentAudienceBody: Open commenting beyond the space setting. A page can only open more, never less.
permissions.commentGuests: Guests with a view link may comment

spaceTheme.title: Theme
spaceTheme.body: Choose an accent colour for this space. It overrides the workspace accent for everyone viewing this space; light/dark is each person's own choice.

branding.upgradeBody: Upgrade your plan to set a custom accent and logo.

upgrade.title: This feature needs a plan upgrade
upgrade.body: Your data is kept — upgrade your plan to use this feature again.

tenantBranding.title: Branding
tenantBranding.body: Set your workspace name and accent colour. These apply everywhere by default; a space can override the accent.
tenantBranding.logoHint: Shown next to the workspace name in the header. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 512 KB.
tenantBranding.logoType: Unsupported image type — use PNG, JPEG or WebP.

history.title: History
history.empty: No saved versions yet. Versions are captured automatically as the page is edited.
history.restoreConfirm: Restore the page to the version from {{when}}? Current content is kept in history, so you can undo this.
history.diffHint: Compared with the current published version.
history.revertRunConfirm: Revert {{author}}'s latest {{count}} revisions in one step? The page is restored to just before their edits; their revisions stay in history, and checkbox states follow the current live values.
history.revertRunNoBaseline: All visible revisions are by {{author}} — there is no earlier revision to revert to. Review the diffs and restore a version manually.
